nodes.label: System User Management Mockup
nodes.description: Admin System Management UI mockup for SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection). Shows the 'จัดการผู้ใช้งาน' (User Management) screen with a left sidebar (Dashboard, Profile, User Management, API Management, URL Report Management, Flag Management, Analysis Option Management, Model Management, Training Data Management, Model Training Inspection, Queue Management, System Log, Logout) and a top bar with admin identity icons (Access Key, TheeraphatStudent, sample_user). Main panel shows 4 stat cards (3 total users, 1 signed up via SEMD, 1 via Google, 1 via Github), a filter control, User/Admin toggle buttons, and a user table with columns User Id, Username, Edited at, Provider, Role, Action. Sample rows: th33raphat (Admin/แอดมิน, SEMD provider), theeraphatstudent (ผู้ใช้ทั่วไป/general user, Github), natekub (ผู้ใช้ทั่วไป, Google), tr33 (ผู้ใช้ทั่วไป, Google). Each row has 'จัดการ' (manage) and 'ลบ' (delete) action buttons, with pagination controls at the bottom.
